name: The Unsent Letter
summary: In the Deadmines, The Unsent Letter waits to be carried to Stormwind. Its delivery reveals the grievances and shared history binding Edwin VanCleef to the city's master builders.

sections.title: A Message From the Grave
sections.body: Edwin VanCleef falls aboard his juggernaut beneath Moonbrook, leaving behind more than a broken rebellion. A newly penned, sealed letter is tucked into his clothing. He addressed it not to a criminal lieutenant or financier, but to Baros Alexston, Stormwind's City Architect.

sections.title: Architects of Old
sections.body: Carry the letter to City Hall in Cathedral Square, where Baros Alexston once worked alongside Edwin VanCleef during Stormwind's reconstruction after the Second War. Alexston reacts with disbelief at news of VanCleef's death. Horrified by the bandit leader's indiscriminate violence, he recognizes the grievance behind VanCleef's bitter crusade. VanCleef was an uncompromising idealist consumed by betrayal, whose rightful grievance turned to destructive madness.

faq.q: Where do I find the Unsent Letter?
faq.answer: An Unsent Letter is found on Edwin VanCleef aboard his ironclad ship in the Deadmines, deep in Westfall.
Baros Alexston is Stormwind's City Architect. He lives in City Hall, along the northeast edge of Cathedral Square.

faq.q: Why was Edwin VanCleef writing to the City Architect?
faq.answer: Edwin VanCleef and Baros Alexston were fellow stonemasons who rebuilt Stormwind after the Second War. Even after turning to banditry, VanCleef saw Alexston as a former peer connected to the masons' work and betrayal.

faq.q: What does the letter reveal about VanCleef?
faq.answer: Alexston sees VanCleef as an idealist and a romantic to the end, poisoned by vengeance. VanCleef believed his war against the kingdom was justified because the ruling nobility refused to pay the masons.

faq.q: Do I need to finish the main Defias Brotherhood chain before turning this in?
aliases: can i do unsent letter early
faq.answer: No. Any Alliance adventurer who defeats VanCleef can loot and complete the letter, regardless of prior progress in the Defias Brotherhood storyline.

faq.q: Where does this questline lead next?
faq.answer: After you deliver the letter, Alexston sends you to the Stockade to question Bazil Thredd, an imprisoned Defias leader who may know more about VanCleef's plans.

angles.text: For humans of Stormwind, the letter exposes the wounds left by the kingdom's reconstruction. The banditry in Westfall grew from political betrayals within the capital.
As a rogue, you can see how VanCleef's skill as a fighter and organizer gave way to suicidal obsession.
For the Alliance, the letter ties the Defias threat to Stormwind's civic administration and reveals a vendetta beyond a regional outlaw uprising.
